NEW1.name: MRU-B1 Heave Sensor
NEW1.description: MRU-B1 is the heave model of the Inertial Labs Basic (B) motion reference units. It uses solid-state MEMS gyroscopes, accelerometers and a barometric sensor in a small IP67 housing, and outputs in Inertial Labs binary, NMEA 0183, TSS1 and Kongsberg Seatex formats.

specs.v: Heave, with heave velocity and acceleration

NEW2.name: MRU-B1.1 Pitch and Roll Sensor
NEW2.description: MRU-B1.1 is the pitch and roll model of the Inertial Labs Basic (B) motion reference units. It shares the compact IP67 MEMS housing of the MRU-B1 and carries an ABS design assessment.

C01.name: NAVIS Main Control Panel with Joystick
C01.description: The main control panel (MCP) with joystick is the operator control point at a NAVIS DP station. Each NavDP control station combines the panel with a control computer, an LCD display, a communication box, a control unit and a power unit.
C01.model_hint: MCP-06 / MCP-C06 with joystick; MCP-B with joystick (DP operator station)
